source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION for one 0Ah/27h CLR/AAh start, bounded CLR/00h status polling, verified export and owner-directed restore.

old_problem: The historical review correctly treated full SDR erasure as dangerous but kept its standardized scope/status semantics inside the Pending block. IPMI 2.0 section 33.16 defines the all-record scope, reservation, CLR confirmation field, one-shot AAh initiation and 00h status query; section 33.13 defines whole-record Add reconstruction. Target identity, update modality and an independently rehearsed no-reclear reconstruction package are strict Project readiness gates, so standard semantics can be resolved without fabricating recoverability.
disposition_reason: Define one explicitly authorized OOB 0Ah/27h full clear on an isolated non-production BMC, followed only by bounded 00h status queries, proof of an observable zero-record repository and immediate reconstruction from an independently rehearsed complete package. Execution is NOT READY until the exact model/firmware/population has proven every baseline record and sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control behavior can be recreated without another clear. Bind the remote endpoint, send AAh once only and never retry an ambiguous result; inspect status/repository read-only and follow the preauthorized recovery tree. Generic log clearing, individual Delete, IB credit, blind `ipmitool sdr fill file`, production targets and untested exports are prohibited.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1213-1215 and the next formal row 1399, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The corresponding IB Clear row 1087/new review event 228 was read and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 88 was read from the locked queue and verified as row 1399 / variant 62211dc32a172fd5.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G and section 33.16 assign Clear SDR Repository to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 27h. It erases all SDR records and reinitializes the repository subsystem; it is not single Delete, SEL clear, Device SDR enumeration or an OEM-selected subset.

The six request bytes are Reservation ID LS/MS, ASCII C/L/R (43h/4Ch/52h), and operation AAh to initiate or 00h to obtain erasure status. Response progress low nibble is 0h in progress or 1h complete; reserved high-nibble values are not ignored.

The specification warns that Clear is principally a development/production aid and should generally be avoided by utilities and management software. Therefore the target must be isolated/non-production with external safety observation and immediate full-scope confirmation.

Requester/session and reservation must match the current repository owner. The runner obtains a fresh 22h reservation immediately before confirmation and proves the required modal/non-modal state from Repository Info plus target authority; any endpoint/session/reservation/mode ambiguity is NOT READY.

The pre-clear package contains every raw record, SHA-256 manifest, canonical version/type/stable-key/body multiset, repository metadata and decoded sensor/threshold/event-enable/inventory/control baseline. Volatile RIDs/timestamps remain audit evidence but are excluded from logical equality after reconstruction.

Section 33.13 whole-record 24h Add, or separately reviewed 25h when actually needed and supported, can reconstruct records with newly assigned RIDs. Recovery must add into the already-empty repository and verify every canonical record and live semantic effect.

The upstream ipmitool `ipmi_sdradd.c` implementation makes `sdr fill file` call its clear routine before adding. That convenience workflow is forbidden because it performs a second destructive clear and can erase fresh evidence; the recovery runner must be independently shown to avoid re-clear.

An export is not recovery proof. Before execution the exact artifact and no-reclear runner must have restored a matching isolated BMC model, firmware and hardware population with canonical equality and full live monitoring checks.

The empty oracle is progress complete, record count zero and bounded enumeration yielding no complete record before rebuild. Automatic firmware repopulation requires an authoritative quiesce/initialization contract; otherwise the case is NOT READY, not a false PASS inferred from nonzero post-clear records.

AAh is never retried. A timeout or lost response triggers only bounded operation-00h status and repository reads over a verified session, followed by the preauthorized recovery branch. Reset/power-cycle/second clear are not diagnostic retries.

OOB adds endpoint-to-asset/certificate binding, protected credentials and remote-session evidence. The local IB result cannot satisfy this Source Key, and OOB transport failure is not capability-backed N/A.

ED-02 preserves identity; ED-03 forbids guessed OEM behavior; ED-13/ED-15 govern N/A/PASS; ED-17 preserves evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery/approval; ED-34 permits bounded target artifacts; ED-38 prohibits retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Clear SDR Repository (OOB Storage 0Ah/27h) one-shot erase, empty-state proof and no-reclear rebuild
test_case.purpose: On one isolated authenticated OOB target, erase every SDR exactly once, prove the standard asynchronous erase state and observable empty repository, then reconstruct complete logical repository and monitoring behavior from an independently rehearsed package without using IB evidence or another clear.
required_package: Approved non-production BMC/SUT/firmware/hardware population and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus endpoint bound to FRU/serial/certificate where available, maintenance window, independent physical/local safety observer and authoritative repository update-mode contract
Pinned raw OOB transport implementing exact 20h, 22h, 23h, 24h/25h and 27h framing with completion/session capture, credential protection and no hidden retry

Immutable PRE_CLEAR_RAW export of every record plus SHA-256 manifest and canonical version/type/stable-key/body multiset, repository metadata and decoded sensor/threshold/event-enable/inventory/control baseline

Signed/owner-approved REBUILD_PACKAGE and no-reclear reconstruction runner already proven by an independent matching-model/firmware/population rehearsal; every input record, new RID and canonical result traceable
Immediate full-repository confirmation, incident/retention clearance, external thermal/power monitoring, bounded poll plan, abort/escalation tree and independently usable vendor/owner recovery medium
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED FULL-REPOSITORY OOB CLEAR; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant and DNS/IP/certificate/FRU/serial/firmware to one isolated SUT; verify Repository Info, update modality, privileges and maintenance isolation. Capture/hash PRE_CLEAR_RAW, canonical and decoded monitoring/control baselines plus SEL/BMC/OS logs without clearing. Require the matching independent rehearsal for the exact REBUILD_PACKAGE/no-reclear runner. Enter documented update mode only if authoritative target evidence requires it. Obtain fresh 22h reservation R over the verified session and stop on any ownership/content drift. Display endpoint, all-record effect, R, baseline/rebuild hashes, expected zero state and recovery medium; obtain immediate confirmation. Send once over credential-safe LANPlus: `ipmitool ... raw 0x0a 0x27 Rlo Rhi 0x43 0x4c 0x52 0xaa`. Never resend AAh. Poll only operation 00h with the authorized context at approved intervals/bound, requiring completion 00h and progress low nibble 1h with reserved high nibble zero; preserve every sample. Read 20h and enumerate to prove count zero/no complete SDR. Immediately execute prevalidated no-reclear 24h/25h reconstruction, recording every input and returned RID, then exit update mode when applicable. Sequentially enumerate and require canonical equality, coherent metadata and restored sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control behavior. Keep row-1087 IB Clear and row-1213 single Delete separate.
test_case.expected_result: One exact OOB AAh initiation on the bound endpoint is accepted and bounded status-only 00h queries reach complete. Before rebuild, Repository Info reports zero records and enumeration yields no complete SDR. The no-reclear package recreates every baseline logical record; RIDs/timestamps may differ, but canonical version/type/key/body multiset, count and decoded sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control semantics equal baseline with no unrelated errors. Missing support, transport ambiguity, automatic repopulation without an approved observation contract or unverified/incomplete recovery is not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact OOB identity/endpoint binding, authoritative repository/update-mode applicability, immutable complete baseline, prior matching recovery rehearsal, immediate full-scope confirmation, one AAh request only, bounded 00h completion, observable zero state, no-reclear reconstruction and full canonical plus behavioral equivalence. FAIL covers wrong endpoint, exposed credentials, malformed request, second AAh, completion without empty proof, unreconstructed/mutated/extra record, monitoring/control loss or recovery divergence. NOT READY covers production/shared target, absent mode/scope authority, incomplete export, untested rebuild, unavailable independent safety/recovery, inability to observe zero state or unresolved recovery. N/A requires authoritative no applicable writable repository, not OOB error.
safety_gate: Never run on production, shared or remotely unattended hardware. Independent thermal/power protection and owner-controlled local/physical recovery must remain outside the repository and OOB path being tested.
Bind endpoint to asset/firmware and keep credentials out of command arguments/logs. Any endpoint, certificate, session or privilege ambiguity aborts before AAh.
Do not execute generic log clearing. Preserve/hash all SDR plus SEL/BMC/OS evidence before destruction and retain originals immutably.
An export alone is insufficient. Refuse execution unless the exact no-reclear package has already restored a matching isolated target and passed canonical plus live monitoring equivalence.
Obtain a fresh reservation and authoritative update mode immediately before confirmation. Ownership/content drift, unknown OEM record or model/firmware/population mismatch aborts.

Send AAh once only. Timeout/disconnect/malformed response is uncertain destruction: use only operation-00h status and read-only repository inspection, never retry, reset, power-cycle, delete or use `sdr fill file`.

Poll status within explicit count/interval/deadline and reject reserved progress bits. Require observable zero state before recovery; do not treat automatic repopulation as proof without an approved quiesce contract.
Recovery adds to the already-empty repository and never clears again. Any canonical/behavioral mismatch freezes writes for owner/vendor recovery and is FAIL.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/SUT/firmware/population/FRU and OOB endpoint/certificate/channel; repository mode; maintenance isolation; distinct IB/Delete identities
Immutable raw dump/SHA-256 manifest, canonical key/body multiset, repository metadata and decoded sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control baseline
Approved rebuild artifact/runner and prior matching rehearsal proving no-reclear reconstruction, plus independent recovery ownership
Fresh reservation/session, displayed full scope, baseline/rebuild hashes and immediate action-specific confirmation
Single redacted 27h AAh request/response and every bounded 00h status sample, with proof initiation was not retried
Zero-record Repository Info/empty enumeration before recovery; every Add/Partial Add input/returned RID and final sequential dump
Post-rebuild canonical/behavioral equality, protected-session/no-secret audit, preserved logs, PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and explicit statement that this review ran no DUT action
test_case.recovery: If AAh was never sent, stop without mutation. If its response is lost or ambiguous, never resend: query 27h operation 00h within the bound and inspect repository info/enumeration read-only. Once any record is absent or erase completes, execute the already rehearsed no-reclear package immediately and retain every new RID/comparison. If status is indeterminate but canonical content still matches baseline, quarantine the target for owner decision; do not clear again. If reconstruction, mode exit or monitoring/control comparison fails, stop writes, maintain independent safety observation and invoke the owner/vendor recovery medium or reprovision/replace the isolated BMC under separate authorization. Never use reset, power cycle, second clear, generic `sdr fill file` or repeated Add attempts to hide failure.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the all-record scope, exact 27h start/status bytes and empty-state sequence. The Review layer rejects evidence-clearing boilerplate and supplies an endpoint-bound one-shot/rebuild-verified procedure without changing Master.

blocked.reason: Core destructive semantics and standards-based reconstruction primitives are defined. Exact isolated target/mode, complete baseline and independently rehearsed no-reclear recovery are Project execution gates; absence yields NOT READY/no command rather than unresolved meaning.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact isolated BMC/SUT/firmware/population/OOB endpoint and writable-repository/update-mode authority; complete raw/canonical baseline; retention clearance; independent safety; poll bound; independently rehearsed matching no-reclear package/runner; owner/vendor recovery medium and immediate confirmation.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER OOB FULL CLEAR/REBUILD DEFINITION ONLY; NO 20H/22H/23H/24H/25H/27H COMMAND, SDR/SEL CLEAR, RESET, POWER CYCLE OR OTHER DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 33.11-33.16 and Appendix G define reservation/update behavior, Get/Add/Partial Add/Delete/Clear commands, all-record clear scope, CLR/start/status bytes, progress result and warning that Clear should generally be avoided by utilities.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool upstream ipmi_sdradd.c
external_authorities.application: Upstream implementation shows 0Ah/27h reservation plus CLR/AAh and 00h polling, and that `sdr fill file` invokes clear before adding; this supports prohibiting that convenience path during recovery.

project_authority: The SDR/BMC owner binds endpoint and isolated platform, confirms update mode/automatic initialization, approves baseline and independent matching recovery rehearsal, supplies external safety/vendor recovery and authorizes one full clear. The owner cannot waive full export, empty-state proof, no-reclear recovery, canonical/behavioral reconciliation, OOB identity, one-shot initiation or no-retry.
